_comment: Text divergences between openapi/sec-api-public.v1.json in THIS repo and the
datastream-derived copy at autonomous-computer/docs, recorded so the guard can
fail on anything NEW. A ratchet, not a mute button:
- a divergence not listed here fails;
- a listed entry whose text CHANGED on either side fails (the digest pins both);
- a listed entry that no longer diverges fails, so the file must shrink.
digest = sha256(normalized datastream text + NUL + normalized docs text)[:16].
Do not add entries to silence a fresh divergence - fix the text instead.
